issues.desc: CHK-002 files.modify pins the fix to packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts only, but calling configuredValidationCommands() (defined in handlers/verifier.ts) from there would create a two-way circular import: handlers/verifier.ts already imports executeValidationPlan/formatValidationProgressEvent/formatWorktreePollutionDetails/runValidationCommand/stripAnsi from core/validation-executor.ts. CHK-002s own text offers an alternative ("or its callers in checklist.ts") that avoids the cycle since checklist.ts already imports runSingleAllowlistedCommand and is not imported back by either module - this module-placement question should be surfaced as an explicit open design decision for PLAN, the same way the matching-key question already is in Solution Tradeoffs.
